Electrochem. Soc. 2023, doi:10.1149/1945-7111/acc7ce, Table II); slope -0.11 V per decade of chloride (Kaesche 1962, Scully; reported in the review doi:10.1515/corrrev-2022-0077); pH 4 to 8.5: range of passivity from the Pourbaix diagram (Pourbaix, Atlas of Electrochemical Equilibria, 1974), not reproducible with the amorphous Al(OH)3 of this pack; on (regrowth time constant), off (time in s until the film has dissolved outside the pH range) and pits (share of the surface in pits): estimated

ghs.src: mixture rules by hand: sulfuric acid 1 mol/L (about 9 %) is Skin Irrit. 2 and Eye Irrit. 2 (CLP Annex VI 016-020-00-8, SCL); ammonium metavanadate 0.6 % stays below the limits of its Acute Tox. 3 and Muta. 2 (supplier SDS)
